title: Fields Medal Winner Wrote About AI Extinction, Then Joined OpenAI
description:
A Fields Medal winner just joined OpenAI, right after publishing a paper on how AI could end humanity 😅

Jacob Tsimerman won the 2026 Fields Medal, math's version of the Nobel. His earlier paper mapped out omnicide scenarios, AI triggering human extinction.

He thinks AI is about pass humans in math research. So he didnt protest. He went to work on it 🔥

#ai #chatgpt #claude #claudecode #gemini
